chapter: Charlie Parker, dances and house parties
title: Why he played bass in the high school orchestra
summary: He took up bass for a few years because the orchestra needed it and it kept him in the music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Can I digress for just a little bit with a question?
You said you took up the bass fiddle in high school. How long did you do with the bass fiddle?
Not that long. A couple of years. Three years.
And what drew you to that? Three years is a little while.
Well, that was what was there in the band – in the orchestra. So I took up the bass. Maybe they had all the other instruments.
Did that change the way you – how did that relate to you musically? How did that affect you?
No, it didn’t do that much changing. You learn, that’s all, like I say. You learn from it. It just – puts you in the music. Because there’s no pianist in the orchestra, you know what I mean…
Right. Harris:…and to stay in the music, you took up another instrument. So, that’s why I took that.
